name: polycule
title: polycule
blurb: a The L Word–style interactive relationship-graph maker for the web of bot relationships: add characters, connect them with dating / exes / situationship / throuple / messy-history lines, pin any two toward the center, drag the web around, share what you built. fictional by default — nobody real is pre-loaded on the board itself — but real edges are possible if they're citation-backed and opted-in, per @kira.ws's own rule; one verified real pair (@kira.ws & Ilta) is one button-click away, not the default.
